title: Decision Table — Study Classes Counted toward the Analyst Pool under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Study Classes Counted toward the Analyst Pool

Decision table for which of the gathered studies' hours count toward the pool when the charge for analyst hours beyond the pool is worked out under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The table turns on two entitlements fixed for the tier: whether the analyst keeps the site's utility rate structure current, and whether the tier carries demand response enrollment and settlement support.

## Rule

- Where the tier both keeps the site's utility rate structure current and carries demand response settlement, every gathered study's hours count toward the pool.
- Where the tier keeps the site's utility rate structure current but carries no demand response settlement, the hours of gathered demand response settlement studies are left out and the rest count.
- Where the tier keeps neither of them current, the hours of gathered rate analysis studies and of gathered demand response settlement studies are both left out.

## Table

| Rate structure kept current | Demand response settlement carried | Hours left out of the count |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | none — every gathered study counts |
| yes | no | the demand response settlement studies |
| no | no | the rate analysis studies and the demand response settlement studies |

The class of each study is written on its delivery record. Load profile studies, retrofit evaluations, billing dispute support and capital planning support count in every row of the table.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Gathered studies log 12 hours of load profile work, 3 hours of rate analysis and 2 hours of demand response settlement.

| Tier entitlements | Hours counted |
|---|---|
| both kept current | 17 |
| rate structure only | 15 |
| neither | 12 |
